key_insight: VideoGen-Agent turns video generation into an agentic workflow: instead of relying on a single generator, it learns to use external tools to improve prompt adherence, identity fidelity, and temporal consistency. This helps video models handle harder requests involving specialized knowledge, ordered events, and physical realism.
problem_solved: Existing video generation models can produce high-quality clips, but they often fail on prompts that require external knowledge, specific identities, consistent physics, or correctly ordered actions.
method: Trains a multimodal agent with multitask agentic reinforcement learning.
Coordinates external tools for augmentation, generation, and verification during video creation.
Learns when and how to invoke tools to improve alignment between the prompt and the final generated video.
impact: This matters because it shows a practical path for making video generation more reliable on complex real-world prompts. For practitioners, it suggests that combining generative models with tool-using agents can improve controllability and output quality.
